denmark.finding: Commercial and non-commercial reuse of Medstat statistics is permitted with Sundhedsdatastyrelsen and date attribution; transformations must be identified.

norway.finding: Historic anonymous NorPD reports may be stored, printed, reproduced and processed when every report, table or figure cites Norwegian Prescription Database, NIPH.

sweden.finding: Socialstyrelsen identifies its public statistics databases as open data under CC0 and separately requests source attribution for API use.

bronze_boundaries: Keep the three national sources independent; their time coverage, measures, ATC versions and disclosure controls are not interchangeable.
Archive only source-generated aggregate result payloads and their query parameters after source-specific authority; metadata download files are not utilisation results.
Preserve counts, rates, dispensings, DDD, costs, geography, age, sex, period and source-native suppression semantics without manufacturing zeroes from absent cells.
Do not acquire, infer or represent person-level prescription records from any public aggregate surface.
Do not claim current Norwegian coverage beyond the officially documented historic 2020 boundary.
